Jerusalem, Israel
May 24 - June 3, 2010

ISRAEL TOUR
Proposed Itinerary for ISRAEL Tour
May 24 -Depart United States for Tel Aviv
May 25 -Arrive at 4-star Dan Panorama Hotel
May 26 -Visit Elijah statue, Megiddo, and battlefield
site of Gideon against Midianites
May 27 -Drive to visit Beth Guvrin, then the village of
Sderot, which has withstood many Kassam rocket attacks
May 28 -Day in Jerusalem - Mount of Olives, Garden of
Gethsemane, David's Tomb, Dome of the Rock, and the Wailing Wall
May 29 -Enjoy "Jesus" boat cruise across the Sea of
Galilee and see an actual synagogue where Jesus preached
May 30 -Tour one of the "settlement villages" in Samaria -
Tour the hilly area overlooking Mt. Gerizim and Mt. Ebal
May 31 -Tour Hebron and Machpelah, where biblical patriarchs
are buried - Hear guest speaker, Aaron Klein, WorldNetDaily's
man on the ground in Israel
June 1 -Tour Yad Vashem - Tour new Holocaust Museum and
Children's Memorial building and visit the Knesset
June 2 -Visit Herod's famed fortress, the Dead Sea, and return
to airport for departure
June 3 -Continue flight to home destination

Nairobi, Kenya
January 30 - February 18, 2008
Dr. Hansen met with many church and political leaders in
Nairobi, Kenya. Dr. Hansen shared the 1992 Prophecy to Kenya
that God gave him and warned the situation in Kenya will get
worse if the leaders of the church do not repent. The highlight
of trip was a meeting with Vice President Kalonzo.
